response.sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT AlbumId, UnitPrice, Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds AS rate FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND UnitPrice IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM valid) SELECT v.AlbumId AS album_id, AVG(v.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(v.rate) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(v.rate) - o.avg_rate AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM valid v CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY v.AlbumId ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
